The '''Northern Jundland Plateau''' was a region in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], located on the western edge of the area known as the [[Deathly Heat]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a number of wind vanes and [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] were located on the plateau, and a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] visited the plateau to set up an [[ultrasonic scanner]] as part of an effort to locate the [[Shock Drum]], a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that generated seismic vibrations.<ref name="Race Against Doom" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Northern Jundland Plateau first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], and is visited by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class visits the area as part of the class mission "Race Against Doom."<ref name="Race Against Doom" /> The area was pictured, though unnamed, in a map of the Jundland Wastes that appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.<ref name="Explore">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
